# HexenPatch

The patch to connect to Firmament, an advanced private server for Genshin Impact!         

Our Discord server: https://hexenzirkel.dev/ | https://discord.gg/QTcZRRjFTH

### Supported Game Version: 7.0.x

### Notes:
- Please start the game on the official servers to download resources
- If you have any issues you can ask for support on our Discord server
